page.layout: One page, title page. Centred lines from top to bottom: title block in large capitals, a woodcut-style rule and imprint block, a Greek quotation in the middle, then the London imprint at the foot. Oval library stamps at upper left and a seal at right are not printed text.

main_text.l: Πας οἱς ἡ ἀσυνάεπλος ἐστιν ἡ τ χεγρων ἀναγεγφὴ,
ῷ ἀ ἱστοις ὠδὲ ᾶ τῆς ἰσοεἰας ἀληδεύιν δύναλαγ.
Typis Thomæ Roycroft, & prostant apud Gualterium Kettilby, ad insigne Capitis Episcopi, in vico vulgò vocato Duck-lane. MDCLXIX.

page.notes: The Greek lines are set in an italic-like face and are partly blurred; the second and first Greek lines are transcribed with uncertainty. The stamp at the upper left reads BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE ROMA and the seal at right is not text. Google watermark at lower right is not printed text and is omitted. The year is printed as MDCLXIX (1669).
